summary: Drive meshing gears from a shared angular constraint with inspectable pitch circles.
objective: Show two external gears with pitch circles, opposite rotation and a shared speed constraint.
example_prompts: Show two external gears with pitch circles, opposite rotation and a shared speed constraint.

entities.name: Gear wheels
entities.guidance: Model distinct hub, shaft, rim and teeth; use machined-metal roughness at rims and darker bearing housings.

entities.name: Pitch circles
entities.guidance: Overlay tangent pitch circles and the contact tangent; tooth profile is not the pitch circle.

entities.name: Bearing support
entities.guidance: Keep shaft centers fixed and align pivots to their axes; give housings visible bores.

state_contract.model: Ideal externally tangent pitch circles with fixed radii r1,r2>0; imposed no-slip constraint r1*omega1+r2*omega2=0. Author-derived kinematic model, not tooth contact dynamics.
state_contract.authority: One canonical model owns semantic values; derive geometry and labels from it. Keep presentation transforms separate.
actions: Pause and inspect contact tangent velocities.

invariants: Angular velocities satisfy the declared signed radius constraint.
Visual tooth phases and spacing must be checked through a complete cycle.
motion_guidance: Integrate one driver angle at fixed steps and derive follower angle from the constraint and initial phase.
Ramp commanded angular velocity with a declared angular acceleration limit; do not rotate wheels with unrelated loops.
known_limits: The cited source supports v=r*omega; the two-wheel coupling is an authored deduction under the stated no-slip constraint.
No verified involute tooth generator, backlash, torque, stress or collision solver. Use pitch-circle visualization if teeth cannot be made to mesh.
Authored guidance; no scene runtime or visual verification has run for this recipe.

claims.statement: For fixed-axis rotation, tangential speed at radius r is r times angular speed.
claims.scope: This supports the pitch-circle kinematic deduction only; it does not certify a gear design.

object_craft.structure: Model distinct hub, shaft, rim and teeth; use machined-metal roughness at rims and darker bearing housings.
object_craft.material: Machined-metal rims, darker bearing housings and subtly contrasting hubs; avoid mirror finish that conceals tooth interference.
object_craft.articulation: Each shaft and wheel share an axis; follower angle derives from driver angle and the signed pitch-radius constraint.

physical_contract.scope: Constrained ideal kinematics, no rigid-body contact solver.
colliders: None in the ideal pitch-circle model; do not claim tooth collision response.
driving: One angular input and signed no-slip radius constraint.
contact: Pitch circles tangent by construction; inspect visible tooth interference separately.
physical_contract.timestep: Fixed driver angle update; follower derived from driver, render interpolation only.
checks: Full cycle returns tooth phase without drift.
